definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact translated inner-loop statement block; it introduces no execution fact.
definitions.text:
rule INNER-BODY
    => If(
         Call(Attribute(Name("character"), "isupper"), .Exprs),
         AugAssign(Name("strength"), "+", Int(1)) .Stmts,
         If(
           Call(Attribute(Name("character"), "islower"), .Exprs),
           AugAssign(Name("strength"), "-", Int(1)) .Stmts,
           .Stmts
         ) .Stmts
       ) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact translated outer-loop statement block.
definitions.text:
rule OUTER-BODY
    => Assign(Name("strength"), Int(0))
       For(Name("character"), Name("extension"), INNER-BODY)
       If(
         BoolOp(
           "or",
           Compare(Name("best_strength"), CmpOp("is", NoneVal)),
           Compare(
             Name("strength"),
             CmpOp(">", Name("best_strength"))
           ),
           .Exprs
         ),
         Assign(Name("strongest"), Name("extension"))
         Assign(Name("best_strength"), Name("strength"))
         .Stmts,
         .Stmts
       )
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact translated function body used by the entry claims.
definitions.text:
rule STRONGEST-BODY
    => Assign(Name("strongest"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("best_strength"), NoneVal)
       Assign(Name("extension"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("character"), Str(""))
       For(Name("extension"), Name("extensions"), OUTER-BODY)
       Return(
         BinOp(
           "+",
           BinOp("+", Name("class_name"), Str(".")),
           Name("strongest")
         )
       )
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Guarded defining case of the character-score summary for reference-model uppercase codes.
definitions.text:
rule charStrength(C) => 1
    requires isUpperC(C)

definitions.rationale: Guarded defining case of the character-score summary for reference-model lowercase codes.
definitions.text:
rule charStrength(C) => 0 -Int 1
    requires isLowerC(C)

definitions.rationale: Guarded residual defining case of the character-score summary for codes in neither case class.
definitions.text:
rule charStrength(C) => 0
    requires notBool isUpperC(C) andBool notBool isLowerC(C)

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the structurally recursive extension-strength summary.
definitions.text: rule extensionStrength(.IntSeq) => 0

definitions.rationale: Cons recurrence for the structurally recursive extension-strength summary.
definitions.text:
rule extensionStrength(iCons(C, CS))
    => charStrength(C) +Int extensionStrength(CS)

definitions.rationale: Cons recurrence defining the last-character summary by structural descent.
definitions.text:

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the named guard for when the total string projection is meaningful.

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation for the first-maximum code-sequence scan summary.
definitions.text: rule bestCodes(.ValSeq, BEST, _BESTSCORE) => BEST

definitions.rationale: Strict-improvement recurrence defining how bestCodes updates during the left-to-right scan.
definitions.text:
rule bestCodes(vCons(V, VS), _BEST, BESTSCORE)
    => bestCodes(
         VS,
         codesProject(V),
         extensionStrength(codesProject(V))
       )
    requires isStringVal(V)
      andBool extensionStrength(codesProject(V)) >Int BESTSCORE
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Complementary no-update recurrence defining first-on-tie behavior for bestCodes.
definitions.text:
rule bestCodes(vCons(V, VS), BEST, BESTSCORE)
    => bestCodes(VS, BEST, BESTSCORE)
    requires isStringVal(V)
      andBool (
        (extensionStrength(codesProject(V)) >Int BESTSCORE)
        ==Bool false
      )
    [simplification]

         #iterYield(V:Val, list(VS))
         ~> #loopStep(Name("extension"), OUTER-BODY)
         => #bindTgt(Name("extension"), projectStrTotal(V))
            ~> OUTER-BODY
            ~> #loopLbl(
                 #loop(
                   list(VS),
                   Name("extension"),
                   OUTER-BODY
                 )
               )
         ...
       </k>
    requires isStringVal(V)
    [priority(40)]
